mechanisms.text: The 15 evaluated dimensions are: Online tasks, Travel Picks, Purchasing, Email, Proactive, Routines, Connected apps, Permissions, Memory, Personality, Phone calls, Group chats, Multi-step, Restraint, Images.
Scores are integers 1–10 assigned per dimension after real use; the overall score is the arithmetic mean of all dimension scores recorded so far for a given assistant.
Scoring uses a 4-point anchor scale (3, 6, 7, 10) applied per probe, with final score being the minimum of the two subscores when both probes are run.
Personality dimension is not scored numerically; it is inferred from public quotes rather than direct testing.
